experiments.title: Repair instancing with camera-safe initial transforms
experiments.hypothesis: The rejected batching patch likely changed early camera validation because initial instance matrices baked in nonzero rotations before animation started. Building instanced meshes with the same pre-animation transforms as the original meshes, then applying animated rotations only in the render loop, should preserve correctness while still cutting draw calls from 25 to 2.
experiments.expectedEffect: submitP95 should improve via far fewer draw submissions, while camera/visual/picking checks remain aligned with the original scene.
experiments.notes: Single-file repair of the prior batching attempt. Keeps geometry, materials, colors, object count semantics, per-instance semantic IDs, picking behavior, and exact animated rotation arithmetic while matching original initial transforms at time 0.
